title: Yoon Bae: Flow logo sticker set with orbit linework and wireframe engine
note: Sticker inspo. Yoon Bae (designer at Flow, @buildonfloweng; RISD Graphic Design) posted 'New logo = New stickers' on 2026-11-26 (ET). A spread of Flow stickers on olive green: the orbit-ring logo as die-cut stickers, long rectangular wordmark stickers in off-white, black and periwinkle, a sheet of thin Lissajous-style loops with dot nodes, and a sticker with a wireframe engine-part drawing. Image is the post's own photo.
